name: Aruba Migration Tool
author: Aruba.it

sections.description:
Aruba WordPress Migration Tool is a plugin that lets you transfer a WordPress website and database from one webspace to another one managed by Aruba.

Using this tool allows you to save time and perform the transfer securely and automatically. The plugin is used by entering a token, generated in the Aruba Hosting customer area.

Activating the Aruba WordPress Migration Tool will create a backup of content on your Aruba Hosting platform before deleting it to make space for the WordPress site that has been migrated.

Before continuing, please check that there is nothing on the WordPress website being transferred that could impede migration, for example:

  • Visualization errors
  • DNS problems
  • Login security measures (e.g. 2 factor authentication)
  • Personalized WordPress login pages

Third party resources we use:

  • The plugin uses Aruba API to comunicate with internal Migration services to transfer data via secure channel from external hosted site to Aruba hosting.
    WPorchestrator in an initial phase verifies a token for validation of the data transfer, after which a backup of the site is created locally, which is passed to the WPorchestrator which uploads it to the S3 storage, at the end of the export, again the orchestrator moves the installation to the Aruba servers, all this is done in https and automatically.
  • Please refer to our Terms and conditions for all the relevant legal matters
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit ‘Plugins -> Add New’
  2. Search for ‘Aruba Migration Tool’
  3. Activate Migration Tool from your Plugins page.
  4. Click ‘Settings -> Aruba Migration Tool’

From WordPress.org

  1. Download Aruba Migration Tool.
  2. Create a directory named ‘aruba-wp-migration-tool’ in your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory, using your preferred method (ftp, sftp, scp, etc.).
  3. Activate Aruba Migration Tool from your Plugins page.
  4. Click Options from your Plugins page
sections.faq:
What is a migration tool?

This is a tool that lets you quickly and securely transfer and configure a website on another webspace and save time in the process.

What does the plugin do?

Aruba WordPress Migration Tool allows you to automatically move all content from your WordPress website to a new webspace managed by Aruba.

My website isn’t hosted on an Aruba hosting platform, so can I use the plugin?

You can install the plugin, but it has been designed to work with the Aruba hosting platform system. Buy an Aruba hosting service and use the plugin to transfer your website.

What do I need to launch the migration?

To migrate a WordPress website securely and successfully, it must be updated to the latest versions of WordPress, PHP and MySQL.
